title: Marrakech - Marrakech - Vacations, travel tours, visits | Moroccan National Tourist Office
facts: Morocco’s official tourism website lists Jemaa el-Fna, Majorelle Garden, El Badi Palace, Koutoubia and the Menara basin among Marrakech attractions.
The site describes the medina and souks as major parts of a city visit.
